summary: The evidence-first complete alternative is faithful after the survey-basis repair and has no open reader defect. Parent pre-score review agrees on fidelity and treats the route as a trade-off, not a guaranteed quality win. Native Human is 0.5177710%, below draft-1's 0.6336482% and above source's 0.1958006%. Preserve draft-1 as the stronger eligible checkpoint. No additional wording search is warranted.
